samples.title: Der Mann am Fluss
samples.author: Lekto
samples.attribution: Text: original, dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Meanings: Wiktionary data under CC BY-SA 4.0, extracted from the Lekto dictionary packs.
paragraphs: Der Mann wohnt in einem kleinen Haus am Fluss. Am Morgen ist der Himmel blau und der Fluss kalt. Der Mond ist noch groß über dem Tal, und auf dem Stuhl sitzt eine Katze. Im Keller ist eine Tasche mit Kartoffeln, Butter und Reis. Auf dem Balkon liegt eine warme Decke. Die Schokolade ist gut. Im Garten schläft eine Schlange. Es regnet.
Am Abend ist es kalt. Der Zucker ist weiß, und die Katze sitzt auf dem Stuhl. Der Mond steht über dem Tal.

samples.title: The Fisherman and the Fish
samples.author: Lekto
samples.attribution: Text: original, dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Meanings: Wiktionary data under CC BY-SA 4.0, extracted from the Lekto dictionary packs.
paragraphs: The old fisherman rowed his small boat across the calm water. He had left the harbour before dawn, when the sky was still dark. He could see his breath in the cold air. A gentle wind pushed the boat forward, and the lights of the village slowly vanished behind the cliffs.

He cast his net near a line of rocks and waited. The sea was quiet, and the only sound was the slow breath of the waves against the wood. After a while, the net grew heavy. He lifted it in with careful hands, afraid that the rope might break.

Inside the net was a single silver fish, bright as a coin. The fisherman looked at it for a long moment. Then he opened his hands and let it fall back into the deep water. Some things are worth more than a full basket, he thought, and rowed home.

samples.title: El hombre y el mar
samples.author: Lekto
samples.attribution: Text: original, dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Meanings: Wiktionary data under CC BY-SA 4.0, extracted from the Lekto dictionary packs.
paragraphs: El hombre es viejo. Su barco es pequeño. El mar está tranquilo. El cielo está azul. En la colina hay un castillo. En el jardín hay un conejo. El viento está frío. El pájaro es azul. El océano está lejos. En la caja hay una maleta.
Por la noche hay una tormenta. Después de la lluvia, el hombre está bien. Vuelve a casa.

samples.author: Lekto
samples.attribution: Text: original, dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Meanings: Wiktionary data under CC BY-SA 4.0, extracted from the Lekto dictionary packs.
paragraphs: Le capitaine est vieux. Son bateau est petit. La mer est calme. Le ciel est gris. Sur la colline, il y a un château. La forêt est proche. Le vent est froid. Le poisson est beau. Le soir, il y a une lampe dans la maison. Une tempête arrive sur la mer, et un orage arrive au loin.
Dans la boîte, il y a un fromage et une bouteille. Après la tempête, le capitaine est content. Il rentre à la maison.

samples.title: Il padre e il temporale
samples.author: Lekto
samples.attribution: Text: original, dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Meanings: Wiktionary data under CC BY-SA 4.0, extracted from the Lekto dictionary packs.
paragraphs: Il padre è vecchio. La sua barca è piccola. Il mare è bello. Il cielo è blu. Sulla montagna vedo un castello. Il giardino è vicino. In autunno il tempo è grigio. La domenica il padre suona la chitarra. Al tramonto il cielo è rosso. Il cane è bianco.
Il mare è grande. Nella scatola vedo un libro e un fiore. Di notte vedo un temporale. Dopo il temporale, il padre è felice. Torna a casa.

samples.author: Lekto
samples.attribution: Text: original, dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Meanings: Wiktionary data under CC BY-SA 4.0, extracted from the Lekto dictionary packs.
paragraphs: 男が家にいる。家は小さい。海は大きい。山がある。犬がいる。本と水がある。塩と橋がある。机とペンがある。そらが見える。冷蔵庫にジュースがある。机の上にトマトがある。夜、雨が来る。男は元気だ。家に帰る。
男は本を読む。水を飲む。夜、雨が来る。男は元気だ。

samples.title: O homem e o furacão
samples.author: Lekto
samples.attribution: Text: original, dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Meanings: Wiktionary data under CC BY-SA 4.0, extracted from the Lekto dictionary packs.
paragraphs: O homem é velho. O seu barco é pequeno. O mar está belo. O céu está azul. Na montanha vejo um templo. O jardim está perto. O vento está frio. O cão é branco. À noite vejo um furacão. Na cozinha, a batata está na geladeira.
O mar é grande. Na caixa vejo um livro e uma flor. Depois do furacão, o homem está bem. Volta para casa.

samples.title: Yaşlı adam ve deniz
samples.author: Lekto
samples.attribution: Text: original, dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Meanings: Wiktionary data under CC BY-SA 4.0, extracted from the Lekto dictionary packs.
paragraphs: Yaşlı adamın küçük bir evi var. Ev denize yakın. Gök mavi, hava soğuk. Dağda bir kale var, bahçe yakın. Gece bir fırtına çıkar. Mutfakta bir buzdolabı var. Masada bir portakal, bir ayna ve bir limon var. Köpek beyaz.
Deniz büyük. Bir kitap ve bir elma var. Bir fırtına var. Fırtınadan sonra adam iyi. Eve gider.
